cc:Work.dc:title: B | Store values or recompute?
cc:Work.dc:description: Eight exact integer features · retained source arrays · four access patterns; all methods and corpora shown. Query cells are ratios of medians of nine trials; lower is faster. Working storage: source arrays + derived representation + indexes/objects + cache/scratch + common schedule. Accounted storage is not RSS. Build: nine-trial median and min–max; 0* means below recorded resolution, not free setup. Logical caches reset before workloads. No confidence intervals.
